name: ELMA Wiki

compute.name: Wiki production container host (CT)
compute.notes: Container elma-wiki under /opt/elma-wiki behind Caddy with a local CA; updated from a clean main checkout by npm run prod:update (deploy/README.md).

providers.name: VK Teams bot
providers.notes: Login bot polling and request bot (VK_* variable names in .env.example).

providers.name: ELMA365 configuration servers
providers.notes: Source and Target connections for configuration comparison and delivery (docs/contracts/source-target-connections.md).

backups.name: Pre-rollout private backup on the CT
backups.notes: Writes paused for a consistent backup before each rollout; restore is manual. Not recovery evidence.

secrets.current: Operator workstation .env (PROD_* SSH connection settings including a shared SSH/sudo password, VK, SMTP and GitHub tokens) and the runtime environment on the CT.
secrets.target: Infisical-held SSH key for production updates, no shared sudo password (owner decision netbka/engineering-platform#82); other machine secrets in Infisical.
secrets.notes: Variable names only. Do not copy values into the registry.

notes: Product: compare and merge parallel ELMA configuration changes into one installable release for an explicit target (docs/SOLUTION_FIRST_PRODUCT_PLAN.md).
Supervisor campaigns elma-wiki-planning and elma-wiki-execution (campaigns/ in this repository) target this project; they run on a second owner PC.
The repository adopts Dyk mechanics at pinned commits; it does not yet route agents to the portfolio Constitution.

exceptions.summary: Production updates read a shared SSH/sudo password from a local .env instead of an Infisical-held key. Review date proposed.

gaps.summary: Shared sudo password in a local .env is a root-level credential agents can reach; no exception allowed. Asked: Infisical-held SSH key. Review date proposed.
